scope: L01 OPI 3 only plus beginner cardinal 10-99 numeric-context rule

decisions.statement: Approve the 0-9 spoken forms BIZO, DUVE, HOYU, KETI, LUSO, MUPI, NURA, PEVU, TOMI, ZOKA for governed beginner numeric use while retaining CANDIDATE authority.
Approve DIGIT_TENS DIGIT_UNITS as the v1.1 positional decimal composition for spoken cardinals 10-99 in numeric/cardinal context only.
Accept EN KU SARASALA KE as the governed L01 v1.1 contextual age question, with SARASALA retaining WATCH authority and no claim that this was the recovered historical sentence analysis.
Accept a bare spoken cardinal 0-99 as a sufficient age answer in this OPI context, without creating an unrecovered HNK word for year/years.

explicit_non_effects: Does not promote SARASALA from WATCH.
Does not promote numeral primitives from CANDIDATE.
Does not claim historical recovery of the number system or age construction.
Does not create a year/years lexeme.
Does not define 100+, ordinals, fractions or arithmetic language.
Does not affect OPI 1 or OPI 7.
approval_basis: User explicitly instructed to proceed with the prepared next gate after the batch and its projected effects were presented.
